Codaru icon catalog v1

Material: 24 SVG icons from google/material-design-icons, Apache-2.0.
Web: 24 SVG icons from lucide-icons/lucide, ISC (including upstream Feather notices).
Exact upstream commit IDs, original paths and SHA-256 hashes are in icon-sources.json.
The adjacent license files are the complete, unchanged upstream LICENSE files.

Bundled SVG data: src/icon-data.ts. Upstream geometry is unchanged. Outer SVG
wrappers, dimensions, XML namespaces and invisible canvas paths were removed;
color is supplied by Codaru. No fonts, logos, network requests or runtime
packages are required. HTML/SVG document exports include exact upstream license
notices for the packs present in the document.

Mac and Linux packs are original drawings authored for this project. They do
not contain SF Symbols or GNOME assets, and do not imply platform endorsement.
Their artwork follows the project's own terms; upstream licenses apply only
to the explicitly identified Material and Lucide subsets.
